A BETTER FIRST REPAIR

A few simple steps.

Get the most out of your cleanup workspace.

01

Choose your clip

Upload a browser-playable video up to 500 MB. Your video is processed on your computer in the local studio.

02

Mark the watermark

Pause at a clear frame and drag a box over the logo. Leave a small margin. This version uses a fixed box for the entire video; moving logos need a different workflow.

03

Review the result

Spatial repair fills the selected area from its surroundings. It works best on simple backgrounds. Inspect for smearing and artifacts before downloading.
